description: This source file contains functions and classes for generating synthetic time budgets and analyzing time-based behavioral data within the BORIS software. It includes methods for initializing behavior data structures, calculating statistical measures like standard deviation, and processing observation data into structured datasets for analysis.

classes.name: StdevFunc
classes.description: Class to enable standard deviation calculation within SQL queries, implementing Welford's algorithm for online variance computation.

methods.name: default_value
methods.description: Returns default duration or proportion values for point or state behaviors based on behavior type and parameters.

methods.name: init_behav_modif
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary structure for behaviors and modifiers per subject with default values.

methods.name: init_behav_modif_bin
methods.description: Initializes a similar structure as init_behav_modif, optimized for binary behavior presence tracking.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget_bin
methods.description: Creates a dataset representing a synthetic time budget divided into time bins, aggregating behavior durations and occurrences within specified intervals.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget
methods.description: Generates a dataset with a synthetic overall time budget from aggregated event data, including statistical measures.

methods.name: time_budget_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes time budget data, extracting counts, durations, and statistics, optionally grouped by behavior categories.
